author: Topsy
description:
Anatu Prime, Blood Angels, Death Company: the Second Company arrives with both nobility and savagery. Bringing both nobility and savagery, the Blood Angels of the Second Company arrive on Anatu Prime. It’s obvious these Sons of Sanguinius are revelling in the carnage of battle – though considering the Death Company swelling their ranks, perhaps they are enjoying it more than is appropriate.

The post This grimdark Blood Angels army is fast, bloody, and painted almost entirely with a sponge appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: This grimdark Blood Angels army is fast, bloody, and painted almost entirely with a sponge
